93	    """Insert a manually-entered router.
94

111	                   VALUES (?, 'Unknown', ?, ?, ?, ?, 1, ?)""",
112	                (ip, port, username, encrypted_password, alias, owner_id),
113	            )

116	            raise RouterAlreadyExistsError(f"Router IP {ip} already exists") from e
